company.name: Prembly
company.shortDescription: Prembly is a KYC Verification Company.
company.description: Prembly  provides company verification services throughout Africa. It consistently serves hundreds of brands in Fintech, Insurance, Mobility, E-commerce, HR management, Crypto spaces, and many other sectors with multiple service offerings. The company protects brands from the occurrence of ID thefts while also assisting these brands in improving their customer onboarding (sign up and verification) processes.
